主要内容: Johnson & Johnson (JNJ -0.55%) is on track for its second-best year of the century, with a 24% stock price increase. The company's share price and dividend payout are at all-time highs. In 2017, J&J acquired Abbott Medical Optics for $4.3 billion and Actelion for $30 billion, adding three pulmonary hypertension drugs expected to generate over $1.5 billion in revenue. Remicade, J&J's top-selling product, faced competition from Pfizer (PFE +0.43%), but sales remained strong, representing nearly 9% of total revenue. Other drugs like Stelara and Invega Sustenna showed strong growth, while Darzalex is expected to become a blockbuster. Pfizer sued J&J over Remicade's exclusivity, highlighting ongoing competition. J&J also received regulatory approval for Tremfya in June 2017 and filed for apalutamide in October 2017. Despite lower gains than previous years, the company is expected to deliver solid performance in 2018. Securities explicitly mentioned in the source include Abbott Laboratories (ABT).
